simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to מַהֲלֻמָּה (H4112) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: מַהֲלֻמָּה (mahălummâh) means a blow First listed occurrence: Prov 18 6.

definitions.full: H4112. mahalummoth מַהֲלֻמֿוֺת noun feminine plural strokes, blows (compare Phoenician מהלם stroke, stamp, impression , once on a coin אגדר מהלם coinage of Gader (Gades), = percussura , κόμμα , Ges Mon.pl.40,xiv. c also p. 307 ) — Prov 18:6 (compare Baer) 19:29 , both times of blows on the body.
